exitCodes.meaning: The human resolved every conflicted path; the payload is the resolve reply (per-path resolutions).
Invalid arguments — missing --wait, more than one pathspec, an empty pathspec, or a malformed --timeout.
The Switchyard app is not running. Resolve never launches the app.
The request was superseded by a newer resolve for the same repository, or the app could not serve it — no reply was received.
The app quit before the human decided — never reported as a decision.
The human cancelled; nothing was staged and nothing was touched; the payload still carries the cancelled reply with ok:true.
Conflicts remain after the reply (blocked_on_conflicts) — some paths were left unresolved; the payload still carries the reply with ok:true.
No reply arrived within --timeout — a typed timeout outcome, never a cancellation and never an app failure.

flags.help: Give up the wait after this many seconds (default 3600). On expiry the CLI exits 10 with a typed timeout outcome — never a cancellation.
Block until the human resolves or cancels. Required in this build; a non-blocking form does not exist yet.

summary: Open the three-way merge UI for the repository's conflicts and block until the human resolves them, cancels, or the wait times out.
